headline: Apple Creator Studio gets powerful new AI features using OpenAI models
summary: The creative suite now integrates advanced AI capabilities, leveraging OpenAI's cutting-edge models for enhanced functionality. These updates are now available.
details: Apple has announced significant updates to its Creator Studio, integrating powerful new AI features. These enhancements are designed to streamline creative workflows and unlock new possibilities for users.

The core of these updates involves leveraging advanced AI models developed by OpenAI. This integration allows Creator Studio to offer sophisticated AI-driven tools directly within the creative process.

While specific details on all the AI features are still emerging, the focus is on providing users with more intelligent and automated assistance. This could range from content generation to advanced editing capabilities.

The availability of these new AI features was confirmed by Apple, with the updates now rolling out to users. This move signifies Apple's continued investment in AI and its application within its software ecosystem.

headline_marked: Instagram launches [[Edits for Mac]] with multi-track video editing
headline: Instagram launches Edits for Mac with multi-track video editing
summary: The free video editing app now offers advanced features like 4K exports and AI-powered tools for Mac users.
details: Instagram has released a dedicated Mac version of its free video editing application, Edits. This move brings powerful editing capabilities directly to desktop users, allowing for more complex video creation and refinement.

The new Edits app for Mac supports multi-track video editing, providing users with greater control over their projects. This feature is crucial for layering footage, audio, and effects to create polished final products.

Users can now export their edited videos in stunning 4K resolution, ensuring high-quality output suitable for various platforms. The app also incorporates AI-powered tools to enhance the editing process, making advanced techniques more accessible.

This desktop release positions Instagram Edits as a direct competitor to other popular video editing software, aiming to capture users who prefer a more robust editing experience than what is available on mobile alone.
